question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Which section did you like best?
What did you think of the bonus scene?
options: I didn't see the bonus scene...

labels: I'm going to be on TV?!
You all get to be on TV!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Want to talk about it?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No... I just want to go home...
Sara slams the door in Jessica's face!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Whoa!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Just drive, Linda.
Linda accelerates out of the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I promise... You `will` regret this!
Sara closes the car door, and Linda drives out of the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I `need` Ben to win!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]need[/i][/color] Ben to win!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Since you're not going to budge on the interview thing, I would be totally willing to help you...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: How are `you` going to help `me?`
nodes.text_bbcode: How are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] going to help [color=#3b78e2][i]me?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Come on, Sara... I know what life for you must be like.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No dates, no friends, no life.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I have a life!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sure you do. And since you have a life, you've been kissed... How many times?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: The number of times that I've been kissed doesn't indicate what kind of life I've had!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh huh, so, I'll just assume `zero times...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh huh, so, I'll just assume [color=#3b78e2][i]zero times...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm having a long day, and I'd just like to go home. Linda's waiting for me...
Sara breezes past Jessica, who follows her...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: She can wait for this... I can give you what you want, Sara. I can give you a life of guys and parties and fun!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: When did you become a genie?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Joke about it all you want, but deep down everyone wants to be `that` girl. Even you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Joke about it all you want, but deep down everyone wants to be [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] girl. Even you.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That girl?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `That` girl. The girl all the girls want to be. The girl all the guys want to be with.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] girl. The girl all the girls want to be. The girl all the guys want to be with.

nodes.text: They reach Linda's car...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And you'll just make all this happen for me?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Of course! And all you have to do is drop out of the election...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I see... I should have known.
Sara turns away from Jessica, opening the door of Linda's car.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Goodbye... Don't talk to me again.
Sara gets into the passenger seat.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, that's how it is? Fine! But before you close that door...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: This is an election, Jessica. And last I checked, there isn't any rule about becoming `too` popular.
nodes.text_bbcode: This is an election, Jessica. And last I checked, there isn't any rule about becoming [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] popular.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That's kind of what an election is `about,` isn't it? Being popular?
nodes.text_bbcode: That's kind of what an election is [color=#3b78e2][i]about,[/i][/color] isn't it? Being popular?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Maybe...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And I'm pretty sure if you had the opportunity to put Ben on TV, you wouldn't hesitate!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Very clever, Sara! Look...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I wouldn't feel very good if `all` the other candidates got attention from a TV interview...
nodes.text_bbcode: I wouldn't feel very good if [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] the other candidates got attention from a TV interview...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So maybe you just shouldn't do it...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That'd make my life a lot easier... But Nick thinks I should go through with it!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nick! I wasn't counting on him to be so clever...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What did you just say?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Forget about it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If you can't cancel the interview, maybe you `could` have this Tucker guy interview each candidate.
nodes.text_bbcode: If you can't cancel the interview, maybe you [color=#3b78e2][i]could[/i][/color] have this Tucker guy interview each candidate.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well... It's for a sports show...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So, Ben's kind of an athlete!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Ben? Wait a second... You don't care about fairness! You're just trying to get attention for Ben, aren't you?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Pssht! Duh!
Sara and the girls break apart and swim their extra laps...
Afterward, Sara is the last to leave the pool. As she heads for the locker room, Cameron hops down from the stands.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey, Machine!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh, gross. You.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: If by 'gross', you mean 'awesome', yes, it's me.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I `meant` gross. Were you up there the whole time?
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]meant[/i][/color] gross. Were you up there the whole time?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: What's your problem with me?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Look, I know what you're all about, okay?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You've figured me out, is that it?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, I have. You use your looks and charm and a couple of funny lines to attract a lot of girls, but that stuff doesn't work on me. And I just don't have the stomach for it now.
Sara starts to head toward the locker room...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I saw what happened...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You saw what, exactly?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: The race. Your dad. The girls.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And...? If you give me some kind of line, I swear...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Relax, Machine. I saw the pressure you're under. And... I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That's it?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: That's it.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, um, thanks... I guess.
Sara heads into the locker room...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Was Cameron just nice to me?
After school that day, Sara is walking to Linda's car when Jessica steps in front of her.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey, Sara! You look, like, amazing! I love your new hair!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh, thanks, Jessica. Linda's kinda waiting for me right now... She's supposed to give me a ride home.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I heard you're going to be on TV for some sporty thing. Is it true?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm going to be interviewed by Tucker Garrety. He's a sports broadcaster for...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's `really` interesting!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] interesting!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But do you think it's fair? For the election, I mean?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, none of the other candidates are super athletes who only do one boring thing `all` the time...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, none of the other candidates are super athletes who only do one boring thing [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] the time...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No offense...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh huh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: They won't get all the attention you will. So, if you think about it, it's totes wrong for you to be on TV!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I hadn't realized it before, but it's almost like you're cheating!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We `don't` care about being on TV, Sara!
nodes.text_bbcode: We [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] care about being on TV, Sara!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You don't?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We don't?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: No! We just want to show those Wilson jerks that we're better than them!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If I have to hear that Elliana girl call me 'Walrus Hips' `one` more time, I swear...
nodes.text_bbcode: If I have to hear that Elliana girl call me 'Walrus Hips' [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] more time, I swear...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We want to win the tournament, Sara!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Wait, I actually want to be on TV!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hannah...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Fine! I want to win the tournament more... I guess...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The point is... You'd better get your priorities straight!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Whatever... She's selfish, let's just get these extra laps out of the way...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You will?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: If `you` guys are getting on my case about me being distracted, then it's probably true!
nodes.text_bbcode: If [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] guys are getting on my case about me being distracted, then it's probably true!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: We're a team, and I'm committed to representing our team... To winning!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So, you're not going to do the TV interview?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, I'm committed to that too... I just promise that it won't distract me anymore!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Can you make that promise?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I think I can...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I think that maybe you should have someone else interview in your place... Someone who looks kind of like you... Someone with that intangible, Hannah-like quality.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hannah...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Oh, I didn't even think of me, but now that you mention it...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: `I'm` doing the interview, Hannah.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] doing the interview, Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Fine... Let's just get these extra laps out of the way...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You'll make sure of what?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: She'll make sure `she` looks good on TV while we actually `try` to beat Wilson.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I never thought `I'd` care more about swimming than Sara does!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Since when did you stop caring about us, Sara?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I care about all of you!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Whatever... Let's just get these extra laps out of the way...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh no! My rhythm is completely off!
Sara tries to make up for it by flailing her arms faster... But she loses several body lengths on the other girls...
By the time she reaches the wall, she's finished last!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What happened out there, Sara?!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Well, you'd better have a good explanation because you can `bet` we'll be talking about this again tonight, young lady!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you'd better have a good explanation because you can [color=#e23b3b][i]bet[/i][/color] we'll be talking about this again tonight, young lady!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Extra laps for everyone but Linda!
Sara keeps her rhythm and touches the wall an instant before Linda does!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yes! I did it!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What happened out there, Sara?!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What do you mean? I came in first!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Against the other girls, yeah, but not against yourself!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You're going to have to race your best if you're going to hold your own at the Wilson Tourney! You're three seconds off your best pace!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: So? You're distracted, it's obvious!
Sara starts to get out of the pool...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You said everyone who doesn't get first has to swim extra laps!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And by my count, `no one` came in first...
nodes.text_bbcode: And by my count, [color=#e23b3b][i]no one[/i][/color] came in first...

nodes.text: Sara settles back into the water...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: We'll talk about what's distracting you tonight, young lady.
Coach storms off, knocking over a life preserver on the way!
The rest of the team swims over to Sara, forming a circle around her...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm sorry, girls. I think my dad's just high-strung because the tournament's coming up.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We're used to your dad freaking out about `every` race... But he's got a point this time!
nodes.text_bbcode: We're used to your dad freaking out about [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] race... But he's got a point this time!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What point is that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That you `are` distracted, Sara!
nodes.text_bbcode: That you [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] distracted, Sara!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: It shouldn't have even been a close race!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's true, Sara... You're way faster than me!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It's all because of this TV interview for her campaign!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe you're doing one! It's kind of selfish, Sara! It's like you're sacrificing us to boost `your` Presidential campaign!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe you're doing one! It's kind of selfish, Sara! It's like you're sacrificing us to boost [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] Presidential campaign!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What? That's not true at all... I promise you... I'll make sure...

options.label: You all get to be on TV!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: This is it, Sara! The final leg. Keep your rhythm. Left, right, left.
As Sara and Linda swim side-by-side, Sara's left arm hits the water...
Then, her right...
Then, her left...
Then, her...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What was all that talk from my father about interviews and... And boys?!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: How did he find out? Oh no... Is he going to ask me father-daughter questions? I don't want... `The talk.`
nodes.text_bbcode: How did he find out? Oh no... Is he going to ask me father-daughter questions? I don't want... [color=#3b78e2][i]The talk.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Do dads do that with their daughters? Gross!
Sara sees Linda reach the far wall before she does!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm behind!

nodes.text: What was all that talk from my father about interviews and... And boys?!

nodes.text_bbcode: How did he find out? Oh no... Is he going to ask me father-daughter questions? I don't want... [color=#3b78e2][i]The talk.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Do dads do that with their daughters? Gross!
Sara sees Linda reach the far wall before she does!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm behind!
Sara hits the far wall at top speed!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: All right! Stay focused!
Sara sees Linda out of the corner of her eye, keeping pace in the lane next to her!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What was all that talk from my father about interviews and... And boys?!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: How did he find out? Oh no... Is he going to ask me father-daughter questions? I don't want... `The talk.`
nodes.text_bbcode: How did he find out? Oh no... Is he going to ask me father-daughter questions? I don't want... [color=#3b78e2][i]The talk.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Do dads do that with their daughters? Gross!
Sara sees Linda reach the far wall before she does!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm behind!
Sara's mind feels empty...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What am I doing?
Linda reaches the far wall before Sara does!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm behind!
As Sara starts the last lap...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What am I going to say to Tucker Garrety?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What kind of questions is he going to ask?!
Sara's pace slows!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh no! I'm losing momentum!
Sara touches the near wall before the other girls!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yes! I need to keep this pace up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What am I going to say to Tucker Garrety?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What kind of questions is he going to ask?!
Sara's pace slows!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh no! I'm losing momentum!
Sara's mind becomes a complete blank... She shakes the cobwebs off...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Where's my head?!
As Sara gets closer to the near wall...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But how am I supposed to stay focused now that Nick scheduled this interview?!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: He could have asked me ahead of time!
Sara comes out of her trance to see that she's fallen a full body's length behind!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh no! Gotta catch up now!
Sara clears her mind and shoots ahead of the other girls!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: All right! I'm picking up the pace!
Sara's pace slows as she tries to focus on something, anything...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's like I can't make up my mind!
The water is cold and unforgiving. Normally, Sara's used to the feeling, but today every second in the water causes her nerves to prickle with pain...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Gotta stay focused...
She hits the far wall a split second behind the other girls...
Sara is slow to react... She jumps into the water only after the other girls have already entered!
Sara gets a good start, diving into the water just ahead of the other girls!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I `am` sorry, Sara. I should have asked you ahead of time...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] sorry, Sara. I should have asked you ahead of time...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm guessing it's too late to cancel...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: We could still cancel, but I don't think that's a good idea.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Because this is your big chance, Sara! The latest numbers indicate that the vote is going to be close! This is the shot to your popularity that can make you President!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Imagine how many votes you'll swing when you wrap up an interview for a TV sports show `and then` go out and win the `Wilson Freestyle Tournament!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Imagine how many votes you'll swing when you wrap up an interview for a TV sports show [color=#e23b3b][i]and then[/i][/color] go out and win the [color=#e23b3b][i]Wilson Freestyle Tournament![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Wait...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You scheduled the interview on the same day as the `Wilson Freestyle Tournament,` the biggest tournament of my swimming career?!
nodes.text_bbcode: You scheduled the interview on the same day as the [color=#3b78e2][i]Wilson Freestyle Tournament,[/i][/color] the biggest tournament of my swimming career?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, well, the film crew needed some shots of you swimming... What better way than in a grueling tournament that culminates with you crushing fierce competition?!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Because I might not win!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But you always win... Don't you?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, against amateurs in our district... But the competition at the W.F.T. is beyond `fierce...` It's like the Olympics of swimming!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, against amateurs in our district... But the competition at the W.F.T. is beyond [color=#3b78e2][i]fierce...[/i][/color] It's like the Olympics of swimming!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Aren't the Olympics the Olympics of swimming?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Not the time for nitpicking, Nick!
Sara suddenly feels dizzy...
The bell rings, and her focus returns...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm late for practice! Oh no! My dad's going to kill me!
Sara takes off toward the swimming pool! Nick calls to her...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Don't worry, Sara! All you have to do is train hard, handle the interview... And then, you know, win the tournament...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Not helping, Nick!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I knew it as I was saying it!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Great... Like Nick said, all I have to do is... Everything...
A few minutes later, Sara is the last of the girls to arrive to practice... She steps onto the only empty platform. On the other side of the pool, her father's eyes burn holes into her...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Glad to see we could `all` make it today! For those of you who think you're special, you are wrong!
nodes.text_bbcode: Glad to see we could [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] make it today! For those of you who think you're special, you are wrong!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: The tournament is `next` week! Wilson High wins it every year, and it's time we changed that tradition!
nodes.text_bbcode: The tournament is [color=#e23b3b][i]next[/i][/color] week! Wilson High wins it every year, and it's time we changed that tradition!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That means you'd better be focused on what matters... Not elections, not TV interviews, not boys!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh no! My dad already knows about the interview!
Hannah whispers to Sara from the platform on her left.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: TV interview? You're going to be on TV?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It'll help my campaign...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You'd better be focused on `winning!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You'd better be focused on [color=#e23b3b][i]winning![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You know, he's talking about you, Little Miss I-Need-More-Attention!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I got it, Hannah. He's not being subtle.
Linda whispers from the other platform to Sara's right.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Psst! I hope you're focused on the meet and not on your campaign! We can't lose to Wilson... They're always laughing in our faces!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Great... I was really hoping for `more` pressure...
nodes.text_bbcode: Great... I was really hoping for [color=#3b78e2][i]more[/i][/color] pressure...

nodes.text: Sara's father wraps up his lecture...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: ...If you don't finish first, you will swim extra laps after practice!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Ready...
The girls stop talking and move to the edge of their platforms...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Go!
Sara's dad blows a whistle!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm not a journalist, Nick. I'm a swimmer. I'm not really used to life in the spotlight... You know how I got before Andrew's interview.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Oh... I guess I'm so used to being around cameras, it didn't even occur to me that you might not be excited.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm nervous already! What if I do something dumb for the interview like... Like... Forget to wear my swimsuit?! I'll be naked on TV!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... I'm pretty sure that's not how Tucker's show works... And just in case, we'll bring a spare set of clothes... Ta-da! Naked disaster averted!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Problem solved? Just like that?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Just like that. You're going to be fine.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I am?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Of course! Not only did we practice your interviewing skills with Andrew last week, `but` you're `'The Machine,'` Sara. If you can go out and swim at a record pace in front of hundreds of people, surely you can answer a few stupid questions from a guy with `really` stupid hair.
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course! Not only did we practice your interviewing skills with Andrew last week, [color=#e23b3b][i]but[/i][/color] you're [color=#e23b3b][i]'The Machine,'[/i][/color] Sara. If you can go out and swim at a record pace in front of hundreds of people, surely you can answer a few stupid questions from a guy with [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] stupid hair.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Thanks, Nick. That makes me feel better...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No prob. I'm just glad you said something. I can't be your campaign manager without feedback.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Then I guess I'll keep complaining.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Now I've got something to look forward to. That said...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Like it? I, uh, `love` it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Like it? I, uh, [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] it!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You said `great` wasn't the word you'd use...
nodes.text_bbcode: You said [color=#e23b3b][i]great[/i][/color] wasn't the word you'd use...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That's because this interview is beyond great. It's uh, awesome!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sara?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So awesome! TV! Whoop!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sara?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I can't wait to stand in front of the camera and talk about my personal life with thousands of people watching at home!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sara, why don't you tell me what you're really feeling?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: How could you set this up without asking me, Nick?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, I thought you'd be excited...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: `Terrified` is more like it... You remember how I was right before Andrew's interview. This is a hundred times worse!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Terrified[/i][/color] is more like it... You remember how I was right before Andrew's interview. This is a hundred times worse!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: An `exclusive` interview with Tucker Garrety!
nodes.text_bbcode: An [color=#e23b3b][i]exclusive[/i][/color] interview with Tucker Garrety!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Tucker Garrety? The handsomest man on television? Sports broadcaster for `Centerscore Scores?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Tucker Garrety? The handsomest man on television? Sports broadcaster for [color=#e23b3b][i]Centerscore Scores?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I've never heard of him.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, I hadn't either until I looked him up online. By the way, `don't do that.` I saw some images I don't think I'll be able to unsee for a long time...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I hadn't either until I looked him up online. By the way, [color=#e23b3b][i]don't do that.[/i][/color] I saw some images I don't think I'll be able to unsee for a long time...

nodes.text: Nick shudders...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Anyway, Tucker's doing a piece on rising high school athletes, and you're at the top of his list! His show has a `huge` audience! Apparently, people actually `like` sports... Unironically!
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, Tucker's doing a piece on rising high school athletes, and you're at the top of his list! His show has a [color=#e23b3b][i]huge[/i][/color] audience! Apparently, people actually [color=#e23b3b][i]like[/i][/color] sports... Unironically!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm going to be interviewed on television...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Pretty great, right?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh... That's not quite the word I'd use.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wait... You... You don't like my surprise?

options.label: Tell Nick you're afraid to be on TV.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What? No! How would me buying you a TV help your campaign for President?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't know... It would boost `my` morale, that's for sure.
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know... It would boost [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] morale, that's for sure.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Never mind... Forget about guessing, I'll just tell you! I got you...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You guessed it!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm glad I guessed it, but...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: And what do we have for our winner? That's right...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Aaaaand... You're not saying anything. Okay, the guessing game is taking too long, so I'll just tell you!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I got you...
Sara keeps her concentration!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yes! I'm really flying through the water now!
When Sara makes the final turn at the far wall, she's two body lengths ahead!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I just have to keep my rhythm, and I'll win!

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.text: `Ma-chine! Ma-chine! Ma-chine!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Ma-chine! Ma-chine! Ma-chine![/b]

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: There you have it! The winner of the match is `Sara!` Centerscore, er... Twin Branches `wins` the Wilson Tournament!
nodes.text_bbcode: There you have it! The winner of the match is [color=#e23b3b][i]Sara![/i][/color] Centerscore, er... Twin Branches [color=#e23b3b][i]wins[/i][/color] the Wilson Tournament!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: I just can't get used to this new name...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I won?! I can't believe it! I won!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Unfortunately, yes. I am too curvy to ever be confused for a machine...
All around Sara are the smiling faces of those she is closest too...
But in this moment, she's happiest to see Nick in the front row...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You did it!
As Sara's feelings for Nick flood her heart, she tries to block them out, but gives up... Besides, in the excitement, no one can tell the difference...
The next day at lunch in the temporary cafeteria, the popular students invite Sara over to their own temporary Center Table.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come sit with us, Sara!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Tell us how it feels to be on TV!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh... Okay!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh... I don't think someone like `Sara` should be sitting with us. We don't want just `anyone` thinking they can sit here...
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... I don't think someone like [color=#3b78e2][i]Sara[/i][/color] should be sitting with us. We don't want just [color=#3b78e2][i]anyone[/i][/color] thinking they can sit here...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What are you talking about? She was on TV! `And` she, like, made that Elliana girl look `way` silly!
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you talking about? She was on TV! [color=#3b78e2][i]And[/i][/color] she, like, made that Elliana girl look [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] silly!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I like her... Even though machines scare me!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The only thing scary about Sara is how fierce she is in the water!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Thanks, guys!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I'm just excited to cast my vote for you for President!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ahem!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I mean, too bad I'm going to actually vote for Ben...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're all voting for Ben, right?
All the cheerleaders avert their eyes from Jessica at once.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I see...
Jessica storms away from the table and out of the cafeteria...
She whips out her phone and finds a number from her Contact List...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Glad I only promised Ben I wouldn't post any more `texts` on The Dirty Dish...
nodes.text_bbcode: Glad I only promised Ben I wouldn't post any more [color=#3b78e2][i]texts[/i][/color] on The Dirty Dish...

nodes.text: After a few rings, someone picks up the phone...

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: I thought I might be hearing from you after that TV spot aired.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: After how high and mighty Sara's been acting... She actually thinks she has a shot at winning! Well, the gloves are totes off!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Post the pictures!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Post the pictures![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Who is Jessica talking to? And what pictures is she posting?
You can find out in the next episode of Surviving High School!
In the meantime, you played a great game! You really were a star!
You helped Sara handle the pressures and win the big swim meet!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: Sara pushes with all her strength! She reaches out her hand, touching the near wall!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't know if I won, but I know I gave my all just now...
Sara flails her arms about, trying desperately to finish the final leg of the race! She reaches out her hand, touching the near wall...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't know if I won, but I know that wasn't my best effort just now...
As Sara lifts her head out of the water, she hears the chants from the crowd...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I hope I don't look bad on my interview!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I hope I don't disappoint my Dad or my sister or my teammates!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And what's going on with me and Nick... I wish I knew what I was feeling...
When Sara makes the final turn at the far wall, she's a full body's length behind!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Great... I've been `completely` distracted!
nodes.text_bbcode: Great... I've been [color=#3b78e2][i]completely[/i][/color] distracted!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Maybe if I get into a rhythm, I can still win!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I've got to maintain my focus, just like practice...
Sara leaps into the water...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Wait... Did the bell go off?
When Sara resurfaces, it's clear that it was a false start...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Ugh...
Sara gets out of the water, embarrassed.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Any of us could be the best if we cheated.
Sara ignores Elliana and gets back on the platform...
A second later...
Sara hesitates for just a moment before the bell sounds, entering into the water a hair later than Elliana...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Bad start...
Even though Sara has the impulse to dive, she waits, her body taut in anticipation of the bell...
A second later...
The bell rings and she dives in, getting out to an early lead in front of Elliana!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Good start...

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Well, there you have it! Sara `The Machine` Kessler, boy-crazy swimmer, winner of the Wilson Freestyle Tournament!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, there you have it! Sara [color=#e23b3b][i]The Machine[/i][/color] Kessler, boy-crazy swimmer, winner of the Wilson Freestyle Tournament!

nodes.text: The camera light turns off, and the cameraman starts packing up the equipment...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What was that about?!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah, what happened to `'nothing but softballs?!'`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, what happened to [color=#e23b3b][i]'nothing but softballs?!'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Whoa! Scandal on aisle six! You're so quick to talk about it!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: There's nothing going on between us!

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Right... You just bring his name up for no reason because you `don't` like him!
nodes.text_bbcode: Right... You just bring his name up for no reason because you [color=#e23b3b][i]don't[/i][/color] like him!

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Can someone get me a bucket of water to throw on this girl, because she's lying so much, her pants are on fire!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm not `wearing` pants!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not [color=#3b78e2][i]wearing[/i][/color] pants!

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: That's a whole different news story, girl!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: This is a swimsuit!

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Uh, that's not where I was going. I wanted to know...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm getting there, Tucker. Let me tell you how much I like Twin Branches.

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: What's happening?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Twin Branches is in a state of disarray. It was completely decimated by the earthquake.

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: There's a hole in the cafeteria floor, we're studying in mobile classrooms, and the library is now a pile of concrete rubble!

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: That sounds like an actual story!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It `is` a story, but what's better is my campaign to try and remodel this school from the ground up!
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] a story, but what's better is my campaign to try and remodel this school from the ground up!

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Your campaign?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You didn't know? I'm running for President!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: I meant to ask you about your apparent crush on a fellow swimmer whose name rhymes with... Hameron.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You mean, Cameron?

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: So it is true! Sounds a lot like young love to me...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: There's nothing going on between us!

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Why are you so quick to deny it?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Because it isn't true!

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: And we all know what an adamant defense means... Wink wink!

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Final question-o! That's Spanish for final question...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So far Tucker's asked me all the questions that Andrew asked me last week!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That means this next one's going to be about whether I have a crush on Cameron.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And I still haven't mentioned anything about my campaign!

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Tell our viewers at home about how much you like...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Of course! You mean how much I like...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: As a swimmer, it seems like the only guys who are interested in me are other athletes...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And jocks, like you for example, are immature, dumb, and obnoxious.
Nick buries his head in his hands...

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Funny that you should so easily label me a jock. Just because I cover sports doesn't make me an athlete. That's why I `studied broadcasting` at Kingston University.
nodes.text_bbcode: Funny that you should so easily label me a jock. Just because I cover sports doesn't make me an athlete. That's why I [color=#e23b3b][i]studied broadcasting[/i][/color] at Kingston University.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You went to Kingston? Oh.

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Oh snap is more like it! Game, set, match... Garrety!

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Maybe the problem is actually how you schmooze with the peeps, Sara, and how quick you are to label them.

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Life tip! Keep the peep label lidded!

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Fakes?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It seems like all the guys who are interested in me say one thing and then do another...
Tucker blushes, tugging at the collar of his shirt.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: For example, one time this guy was acting really nice to me one second...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And then a moment later, he started acting like a `complete jerk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And then a moment later, he started acting like a [color=#3b78e2][i]complete jerk![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: That is... Strange behavior! Let's move on!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, let's!

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Moving on! Q numero two!

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Now that you've so shockingly revealed your lack of a romantic life, I have to ask...

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: What do you have against us dudes? Why the man hatred? Why so `bro`pposed?
nodes.text_bbcode: What do you have against us dudes? Why the man hatred? Why so [color=#e23b3b][i]bro[/i][/color]pposed?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: This is exactly like Andrew's interview! Something is going on...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't have anything against guys, Tucker... I'm just not interested in...
Tucker's face turns red for a moment...

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Ha ha! I don't know about unprofessional! After all, `I` get paid.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha! I don't know about unprofessional! After all, [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] get paid.

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: It doesn't get any more professional than dollars in your pocket! Am I right? Am I right?!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No, you're not right. You can get paid for all kinds of morally questionable behaviors...

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Well... You're just in high school.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What does that have to do with...?

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Well... I hate to break it to you, Sara, but this `is` an interview!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... I hate to break it to you, Sara, but this [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] an interview!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I guess that's true...

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Life tip: If you're going to be in the spotlight like this, `expect everything` to be personal!
nodes.text_bbcode: Life tip: If you're going to be in the spotlight like this, [color=#e23b3b][i]expect everything[/i][/color] to be personal!

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Anyway... Great answer!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'll clean up. Do your homework. Get to bed early for tomorrow's meet.
Sara's father starts putting away the dishes.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: How am I worried about me?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You're just worried that if I become President, I'll stop swimming...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And if I stop swimming, you won't be able to boss me around all the time!
Sara's dad's face turns a deep red!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: If you think for one second that I will ever let you `quit swimming,` you're out of your mind.
nodes.text_bbcode: If you think for one second that I will ever let you [color=#e23b3b][i]quit swimming,[/i][/color] you're out of your mind.

nodes.text: Sara starts to cry...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That's right, I am!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: He's my campaign manager, Dad! He's Sam's boyfriend! And there's nothing between us, okay?!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Except we almost kissed...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All I know is ever since he started spending time with you, you've been distracted...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And you can't afford to be. This is your future. You have to be the best every time you swim.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You've got so much talent... I don't want you to waste it on trivial things like elections.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You don't have to worry, Dad... I'm going to be totally focused tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That's all I wanted to hear...
That night, Sara sits at the dinner table with her father.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: When does Mom come back from her conference?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: This Sunday. She's upset that she's going to miss your big meet. She hasn't missed any of them.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I know...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: `You` haven't missed any of them either...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]You[/i][/color] haven't missed any of them either...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You've never come to a meet without your `absolute` focus.
nodes.text_bbcode: You've never come to a meet without your [color=#e23b3b][i]absolute[/i][/color] focus.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: This interview, your whim to run for President, this Nick boy... They're all just a bunch of unwanted distractions.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But I `want` to be President.
nodes.text_bbcode: But I [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] to be President.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You don't know what you want, Sara.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And you do?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I know what's best for you, and I know that today's practice was one of the most embarrassing moments of my life!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: How? How was that embarrassing for `you?`
nodes.text_bbcode: How? How was that embarrassing for [color=#3b78e2][i]you?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You represent me. You represent this family. And we don't slack off!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You're `my` daughter!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] daughter!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And do you have any idea how hard it is to be your daughter, Dad?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I know you're under a lot of pressure, but the solution is simple! Stop running for President!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh, I get it! Now I know why you're upset... This isn't about me being distracted, you're just worried about...
Sara clears her head and focuses only on the rhythm of her strokes...
Her left arm hits the water, then her right, then her left...
Then her...
Coach storms off, knocking over a life preserver on the way!
The rest of the team swims over to Sara, forming a circle around her...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm sorry, girls. I think my dad's just high-strung because the tournament's coming up.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We're used to your dad freaking out about `every` race... But he's got a point this time!
nodes.text_bbcode: We're used to your dad freaking out about [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] race... But he's got a point this time!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What point is that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That you `are` distracted, Sara!
nodes.text_bbcode: That you [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] distracted, Sara!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: It shouldn't have even been a close race!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's true, Sara... You're way faster than me!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It's all because of this TV interview for her campaign!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe you're doing one! It's kind of selfish, Sara! It's like you're sacrificing us to boost `your` Presidential campaign!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe you're doing one! It's kind of selfish, Sara! It's like you're sacrificing us to boost [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] Presidential campaign!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What? That's not true at all... I promise you... I'll make sure...

options.label: You all get to be on TV!

nodes.text: Sara keeps her rhythm and touches the wall an instant before Linda does!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yes! I did it!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What happened out there, Sara?!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What do you mean? I came in first!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Against the other girls, yeah, but not against yourself!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You're going to have to race your best if you're going to hold your own at the Wilson Tourney! You're three seconds off your best pace!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: So? You're distracted, it's obvious!
Sara starts to get out of the pool...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You said everyone who doesn't get first has to swim extra laps!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And by my count, `no one` came in first...
nodes.text_bbcode: And by my count, [color=#e23b3b][i]no one[/i][/color] came in first...

nodes.text: Sara settles back into the water...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: We'll talk about what's distracting you tonight, young lady.
Sara has failed.
`Luckily,` you get another chance! See if you can help Sara keep her head above water, beat Elliana, and unlock the Good Ending!
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Luckily,[/b] you get another chance! See if you can help Sara keep her head above water, beat Elliana, and unlock the Good Ending!

nodes.text: As Sara lifts her head out of the water, she hears the chants from the crowd...
`Ell-i-a-na! Ell-i-a-na! Ell-i-a-na!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Ell-i-a-na! Ell-i-a-na! Ell-i-a-na![/b]

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: There you have it! The winner of the match is `Elliana!` Wilson High wins the Wilson Tournament once again!
nodes.text_bbcode: There you have it! The winner of the match is [color=#e23b3b][i]Elliana![/i][/color] Wilson High wins the Wilson Tournament once again!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! I am better than a machine! That means I am a goddess!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I guess I lost...
All Sara can see is disappointment on the faces of those she cares about...
Even on the face of Nick...

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: You did fine, Sara. You even managed to sneak in all that lame stuff about running for President.

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Caught me off-guard... No easy feat.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It was easy to anticipate your questions since they were the same ones Andrew asked me `last week!` How did you get them?
nodes.text_bbcode: It was easy to anticipate your questions since they were the same ones Andrew asked me [color=#3b78e2][i]last week![/i][/color] How did you get them?

nodes.text: Whoa whoa whoa! A true reporter never, uh... Something noble about sources... But, yeah, it wasn't some guy named Andrew.

nodes.text: It was some girl. She said it was 'totes' important that I ask you these questions. Paid me a lot of money, too!

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Now if you'll excuse me... I'm getting a mani-pedi, a trim, and then I'll probably do something awesome like watch myself on TV.

nodes.text: You're not even going to stay to watch the meet?

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Great timing! That was an actual yawn by the way! Also, to answer your question, no... Camera Guy's going to film it.

nodes.speaker: Tucker Garrety
nodes.text: Oh, and you'd better win since I said twice in the interview that you won the tournament! Otherwise, we'll all look bad!
Tucker leaves, and the cameraman sets up to film the meet...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure Jessica's the girl behind those questions...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sara? You okay?
Sara thinks about all the pressure she's been feeling...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No! I'm not okay, Nick! I can't handle this!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What's the matter?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What's the matter?! Everything! Everything's the matter!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That interview was embarrassing!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: My dad expects me to break a record every time I swim!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: My teammates think I'm selfish! They're not even the least bit supportive!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Jessica's scheming to tear me down because I'm a threat to Ben!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And my sister is trying to follow in my miserable footsteps!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So how's that for `what's the matter?`
nodes.text_bbcode: So how's that for [color=#3b78e2][i]what's the matter?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm really sorry, Sara...
Nick tries to hold Sara, but she backs away.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No! You're the worst part, Nick...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: How am I the worst? I thought I was being your friend...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I think... I think I like you... But we can't do this because you're with Sam...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's like there's this wall between me and `the one` guy who actually cares about me.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's like there's this wall between me and [color=#3b78e2][i]the one[/i][/color] guy who actually cares about me.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm... I'm so sorry...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, well, it's not your fault...
The silence hangs there indefinitely. Finally...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Are you going to swim?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No... I'm through with swimming... I'm just a big disappointment...
Sara turns and flees from Nick, from her friends and family, from everything...
`Okay!` That ending was a major disappointment! You can't let things stay that way, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Okay![/b] That ending was a major disappointment! You can't let things stay that way, right?

nodes.text: So play again and this time, see if you can help Sara handle all this pressure!

nodes.text: I think so... Just can you do me a favor? Can you convince me that I actually `want` to win the tournament, now that it will mean airing that interview on TV?
nodes.text_bbcode: I think so... Just can you do me a favor? Can you convince me that I actually [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] to win the tournament, now that it will mean airing that interview on TV?

nodes.text: Are you serious? Sara, no matter what, that guy's going to come across like an idiot! And you're going to come across like someone who knows what she's doing!

nodes.text: You think so?

nodes.text: It is. Besides, there is another reason for you to want to win... It's the same reason you wanted to win before you ever heard about the interview...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What's this? Nick Brown's talking about school pride?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Maybe... I'm also talking about Sara pride too...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What's Sara pride?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's you going out there and forgetting about all these distractions and just swimming your best because it's what you love to do...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh yeah... That.
A bell sounds.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's time for the match... Wish me luck.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I would, but you don't need it.
For one moment, Sara feels warm, the same way she felt when they nearly kissed...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I like Nick Brown!
At the end of the meet, Sara stands at the foot of a platform overlooking the water. Elliana limbers up in front of the platform next to hers.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Very happy I'm not going up against the Walrus Hips over there. You... You are more like a pile of bones.
Sara tries to ignore Elliana... She begins to feel the pressure from all angles...

Let's check in with $Travis and Ryan on the day of the swim meet...
$Travis is driving down the road while Ryan throws tomatoes out the window at parked cars!
Hey, $Travis! Do you think anyone's as cool as we are?
I doubt it.
Up ahead, fumes waft up from the hood of a shiny sports car... A man is looking under the hood, his face obscured by the smoke.
Ooh! That one's fancy-looking! You ready?
I was born with this tomato in my hand!
$Travis hugs the edge of the road as Ryan leans out the window, his arm cocked back...
Suddenly, the smoke dissipates and $Travis sees the face of his idol, Tucker Garrety!
Tucker G! Hold your fire, dude!
$Travis slams on the brakes! Ryan pitches forward, and the truck comes to a screeching halt, just inches from Tucker's sports car!
What the?! Dude, I just threw the tomato at my face!
$Travis looks at Ryan... Half his face is covered in dripping tomato guts...
Heh. You look stupid.
You're about to look really stupid if you don't get us out of here!
Don't you know who that is, man?! The legend! That's Tucker Garrety!
Before Ryan can reply, $Travis bounds out of his car and over to Tucker...
You almost hit my car, kid!
Heh. I know who you are!
Oh no.
You look just as handsome as I imagined you would.
Am I about to be kidnapped?
Can I get your autograph?
Sure, just stand far away, okay, kid?
I don't have any pen or paper...
Anything that writes?
I have... Blood?
Please do not go into any further details.
Tucker goes the long way around his car and gets out a marker...
Do you have anything that can be signed at all? A picture or a magazine or something.
Nah. I don't really read much. Mostly me and my friend just work on cars...
You know about cars? Would you and your friend be interested in fixing mine?
Sure! You probably just have an overheated engine!
Whatever it is, fix it, and I'll pay you double for it...
I'd rather have something else...
Oh no... Not my vital organs or anything like that, right?
Heh...
Later, as the sun sets, $Travis floors the accelerator of Tucker's sports car as Tucker leans out the window, holding a fresh tomato!
Now what?
Throw it, man!
Tucker throws it at a nearby car... `Splat!` He pulls his head back inside...
No one is as cool as you guys!
This is the happiest day of my life!
Awww... $Travis got to hang out with his idol... And even though Tucker is pretty lame as far as idols go...
$Travis doesn't know that!
